summary: Master waste management and resource efficiency with practical audits, segregation plans, KPIs, and reporting tools. Enrol today.
lede: Waste audits in waste management and resource efficiency map and classify streams, establish a baseline, and identify reduction and recovery options. This course is for environmental, sustainability, facilities, and operations professionals who need practical ways to improve site-level waste handling and reporting. Learners practise designing segregation systems, tracking diversion, monitoring contractors, and preparing KPIs and action plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage waste data, site handling, service providers, or sustainability reporting and need practical tools they can use immediately.
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with workplace waste handling, environmental procedures, and spreadsheet-based reporting. Bringing a recent waste register, disposal invoice summary, site layout, or contractor report will make the exercises more relevant, but it is not mandatory.
